Package com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka

Class SchemaDiff

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.protocol.kafka.SchemaDiff
public final class SchemaDiff extends Object
Compares two Avro-style record schemas, expressed as JSON, field-by-field so a UI can present a side-by-side version compare. Each schema is a JSON object with a top-level "fields" array whose elements carry a "name" and a "type"; the type may be a plain string (e.g. "string"), a nested object (e.g. an array/record, reduced to its "type"), or a JSON array — an Avro union such as ["null","string"], which is canonicalised to union[null,string] preserving member order.

Fields are matched by name and classified ADDED (only in the new schema), REMOVED (only in the old schema) or TYPE_CHANGED (present in both but with a differing canonical type). Because a union's canonical form lists its members, a field that gains or loses "null" from its union simply surfaces as a TYPE_CHANGED with differing type strings. Fields whose type is unchanged are counted but not listed.

The JSON is read with SchemaRegistryJson, so no external JSON library is pulled in and the whole comparator is pure and offline-testable. Changes are ordered by field name for stable, testable output and the returned list is immutable. Malformed JSON, a non-object schema or a missing/invalid "fields" array raises IllegalArgumentException.
